description: List date-free published events, services, activities, day passes, experiences, dining, wellness, packages, transfers, and other extras for a known property. Returns read-only offer details and ATA purchase links when the property is published on ATA; it does not create an order.

category.description: Optional exact offer category filter, such as DAY_PASS, EXPERIENCE, WELLNESS, TRANSPORT, or PACKAGE.

standaloneOnly.description: When true, exclude offers that require a stay.

name: list_property_extras
